4.2 trillion marks for one dollar. 💸🔊 Germany, 1923: from about 18,000 marks in January to 4.2 trillion in November. Prices doubled every few days. Then came the Rentenmark: 1 for 1 trillion paper marks. The history of money, with sources, in NEXUS. Link in bio. #hyperinflation #weimar #germany #1923 #history #economics #money #inflation #economichistory #studygram

When the dollar was gold. 🪙🔊 Bretton Woods, 1944: 44 countries, currencies tied to the dollar, the dollar tied to gold at $35 an ounce. On 15 August 1971, Nixon suspended convertibility. Events and data, each with its source, in NEXUS. Link in bio. #brettonwoods #gold #dollar #nixon #1971 #monetaryhistory #economics #history #finance #studygram

Tulip mania: the first bubble? 🌷🔊 Holland, winter 1637: rare bulbs traded for huge sums. In February, the collapse. But archive research suggests the damage to the economy was limited. Fact or legend? In NEXUS every claim shows its source and reliability. Link in bio. #tulipmania #bubble #financialhistory #history #economics #netherlands #myths #studygram #finance #investing
